visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a top-down view of a split mechanical keyboard with gray and black keycaps resting on a desk with a large mousepad. (2) The scene shifts to the Computex convention hall, showing the brightly lit 'Republic of Gamers' booth with purple neon accents and multiple product displays. (3) A close-up demonstrates the keyboard splitting in half, revealing the internal magnetic switches; hands are shown manipulating the keys and a side-mounted control wheel. (4) An interviewee in a black suit, Eason Lee, demonstrates adjustable keyboard feet of different heights, showing how they snap onto the bottom of the device. (5) Another interviewee in a tan suit, Kris Huang, demonstrates the keyboard's wireless left-half usage to increase desk space for a white gaming mouse. (6) A close-up of the white ROG Harpe II Ace mouse being placed on a digital scale, which displays a weight of 48.8 grams. (7) A female presenter, Ashleigh Huang, introduces a large black mousepad with red and white graphic designs, gesturing to its surface. (8) The final montage quickly cuts between the keyboard, mouse, and mousepad in a gaming setup with a prompt to leave a comment.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: Men's Game 玩物誌. [Subtitle]: 你還在用傳統的單體鍵盤嗎? (2) [Subtitle]: 今年COMPUTEX上面的ROG帶來全新的分離式鍵盤. (3) [Variety]: ROG FALCATA 鍵盤. [Subtitle]: 它不只可以左右拆開, 而且搭載了二代磁軸. (4) [Subtitle]: 它可以精準的偵測按壓行程, 不論你是要輕按一毫米就觸發, 或者是在壓到兩毫米才啟動, 都可以自訂喔. (5) [Subtitle]: 那或者說要調我們的這個Rapid Trigger, 這樣RT的一個精準度. (6) [Subtitle]: 那當然你要做一些基本的一些Media Playback, 或是說看影片啦, 音量大調聲大小, 這個都可以在這邊去完成去實現. (7) [Subtitle]: 此外鍵盤右上角還多了一個實體切換, 可以讓你迅速在文書輸入, 還有遊戲之間切換. (8) [Subtitle]: 另外背後還提供多種的支架角度, 無論你想要水平的放置, 或者是傾斜抬高, 通通可以自己調整. (9) [Variety]: Eason Lee ROG PM Director. [Subtitle]: 那我們的鍵腳有總共八顆, 有四顆高位的, 然後有四顆低位的, 主要三種調整的形式, 然後有五種角度. (10) [Subtitle]: 輕鬆把它鎖上之後, 有一個是把它鎖在前端, 這是一個角度, 那我們可以鎖矮的, 就可以讓它低一點. (11) [Subtitle]: 那我也可以把拱起來的地方調到中間, 那我就可以有更有, 更接近人體工學的感受. (12) [Subtitle]: 如果你只想專注遊戲, 收起右半邊, 讓滑鼠保留更大的活動空間. (13) [Variety]: Kris Huang GM of Gaming & Workspace BU. [Subtitle]: 超彈性, 它只需要這一塊, 所以在右半邊這邊其實就不用了. (14) [Subtitle]: 那在這一塊的話, 它就是完全的一個無線的一個狀態, 那它可以去調整它需要鍵盤的一個位置. (15) [Subtitle]: 那它就騰出了這麼大的一個空間, 它可以讓它的滑鼠使用, 他可以甩滑鼠. (16) [Subtitle]: 接下來我們來看一下ROG最新的滑鼠. (17) [Subtitle]: 這支是我們在Computex發表的, 這個Harpe II Ace的一個新產品. (18) [Subtitle]: 它這個其實它已經是第二代了, 不過這個第二代, 我們是跟電競的一個選手, 電競玩家共同開發的. (19) [Subtitle]: 這支滑鼠呢在個手型上面, 我們跟它來回應該有調整過, 大概二三十種不同的一個手型. (20) [Subtitle]: 超輕量的設計, 比前一代更輕百分之十, 而且提升了百分之三十的堅固度. (21) [Subtitle]: 還榮獲了這一次的綠色永續大獎. (22) [Subtitle]: 這一次我們其實是用了一個比較特殊的一個材質, 這個叫做Biobase, 就是一個生物基材的一個尼龍材. (23) [Subtitle]: 它這個材料的一個好處, 第一個當然是它非常的環保. (24) [Subtitle]: 其實有時候玩家打遊戲的時候, 可能會特別激動, 所以其實它整個滑鼠的一個堅固程度, 還提升了百分之三十. (25) [Variety]: Ashleigh Huang ROG Product manager. [Subtitle]: 這是我們最新款的電競滑鼠墊, ROG Sheath II XXL. (26) [Subtitle]: 可以看到它的整個設計, 我們這次是走比較新潮一點, 比較stylish, 比較新潮一點. (27) [Subtitle]: 想要去符合我們年輕的電競族群的喜好. (28) [Subtitle]: 在這個滑鼠墊使用的是, 涼感的設計, 就讓你的手會有一個比較涼的這種感覺. (29) [Subtitle]: 以上就是這一次Computex ROG最新產品, 各位心動了嗎? 在底下留言告訴我你最喜歡哪一個產品.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 host/creator, 2 male ROG employees, 1 female ROG employee, and several background attendees.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The host is holding camera/microphone. Eason Lee wears a black suit over a black shirt with a lanyard. Kris Huang wears a tan suit over a black shirt with a lanyard. Ashleigh Huang wears a black blazer over a pink top.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary background is the ASUS ROG booth at Computex, featuring large digital displays, glowing LED signage, product shelves, and numerous convention attendees walking in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic electronic music bed and an enthusiastic male narrator speaking in Mandarin at a fast pace. The BGM has a steady, synthesized beat and bright, percussive elements typical of gaming content. (2) As the scene transitions to the convention hall, a subtle whoosh SFX occurs, and the narrator's voice is joined by a faint, distant hum of a crowd murmur. (3) A new male voice (Eason Lee) enters, speaking with professional clarity about keyboard adjustments. His tone is informative and steady, layered over the continuous electronic music. (4) The audio features a distinct mechanical 'click' sound when the keyboard feet are demonstrated. (5) Another male voice (Kris Huang) takes over, speaking in a calm, authoritative manner with a slightly deeper pitch than the host. (6) A female voice (Ashleigh Huang) is heard in the final third, speaking with high arousal and a friendly, animated tone, describing the mousepad while the upbeat BGM continues at a consistent volume. (7) The final segment features the original narrator returning for a summary, closing with a high-pitched invitation for audience engagement, all while the energetic EDM track reaches its conclusion.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Feature Breakdown -> Interview Segments -> Product Demo -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase and promote the latest ASUS ROG gaming peripherals (Falcata keyboard, Harpe II Ace mouse, Sheath II XXL mousepad) revealed at Computex 2024, highlighting their unique modular designs, technical specifications, and ergonomic features to tech enthusiasts and gamers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct interviews with ROG staff, close-up product showcases with brand logos, and a clear call to action regarding the featured products.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes a high-energy vlog style with on-site convention interviews to build credibility and excitement for the brand's new ecosystem.
